title: Foxx's Scythe Mace
description: Have you ever wanted a scythe as a mace? One with a silly little animation? Well look no further than this one right here!
body: Have you ever wanted a scythe for a mace? Maybe one with fun little animations? Well look no further than Foxx's Scythe Mace! You can slash your enemies with a mace that feels powerful, instead of just a silly little hammer!
